Since publication of our meta-analysis (215), which included studies published up to December 2014, several additional studies have investigated the limits of a volume threshold in people with previous resistance training experience. Some of these studies indicate that the volume threshold may extend up to 30+ per muscle per week (95, 186, 218), whereas others show a plateau at 10 or fewer sets (14).
